steps.en: Install the Python package and FFmpeg; provision the local model cache
steps.zh: 安装 Python 包和 FFmpeg，准备本地模型缓存

steps.en: Ask for a description of your effect file
steps.zh: 请求描述自己的音效文件

steps.en: Decode the sound and compute measurements plus calibrated sound tags
steps.zh: 解码声音，计算测量值与校准声音标签

steps.en: Return a readable description, competing readings and measurements
steps.zh: 返回可读描述、其他可能解释和测量值

value.en: Your agent gets sound evidence instead of guessing from filenames
value.zh: agent 获得声音证据，不再只凭文件名猜测
